skills.name: SSRF assessment
skills.description: Test server-side request forgery on authorized targets.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify URLs fetched server-side (webhooks, importers) via http.capture.
2. Probe with harmless internal references via http.replay.
3. Confirm reachability differences (response timing/errors).
4. Map internal surface reachable from the vulnerable endpoint.
5. Report with evidence and remediation (allowlists, no raw URL fetch).

skills.name: Blind SSRF via callbacks
skills.description: Confirm blind SSRF through DNS/HTTP callbacks.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Set up a DNS/webhook listener you control.
2. Inject callback URLs via http.replay.
3. Record callback arrivals with timestamps.
4. Correlate with request parameters.
5. Report the callback channel and trigger.

skills.name: XXE assessment
skills.description: Test XML entity expansion on owned endpoints.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Find XML-accepting endpoints via http.capture.
2. Probe with external entity references via http.replay.
3. Confirm callbacks to your listener (OOB style).
4. Avoid destructive billion-laughs on production.
5. Report parser behavior and fix (disable DTDs).

skills.name: Deserialization probes
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify serialized blobs in traffic (http.capture).
2. Fingerprint formats (Java serial, .NET, PHP serial) via python.run_file.
3. Craft detection payloads via python.run_file generators.
4. Confirm via non-destructive callbacks only.
5. Report library versions and remediation.

skills.name: Local file inclusion assessment
skills.description: Probe LFI with safe, read-only proofs.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify path parameters consumed server-side via http.capture.
2. Probe traversal patterns via http.replay.
3. Confirm with harmless known files (/etc/hostname equivalent).
4. Map reachable file scope.
5. Report with remediation (allowlists, chroot).

skills.name: Remote file inclusion checks
skills.description: Test RFI safely with controlled callbacks.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate include-like parameters via http.capture.
2. Point to your own controlled URL via http.replay.
3. Confirm callbacks; avoid executing third-party payloads.
4. Document allow_url_include-dependent behavior.
5. Report with configuration fixes.

skills.name: Authentication flow abuse
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map the auth flow from http.capture.
2. Test state machine jumps (skip steps) via http.replay.
3. Probe remember-me and reset flows for logic gaps.
4. Document reproducible bypass chains.
5. Recommend flow-level fixes.

skills.name: Session fixation testing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture pre-auth and post-auth session IDs (http.capture).
2. Test whether IDs persist across privilege changes (http.replay).
3. Attempt fixation with attacker-set IDs on your own app.
4. Document cookie flags alongside.
5. Report regeneration gaps.

skills.name: JWT security assessment
skills.description: Assess JWT handling end to end.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Extract JWTs from http.capture (presence only, redact in reports).
2. Decode header/payload with python.run_file.
3. Test alg=none and key-confusion on your own instance via http.replay.
4. Check expiry/audience enforcement.
5. Report algorithm and verification gaps.

skills.name: OAuth flow review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map the authorize/token dance via http.capture.
2. Test state parameter enforcement (http.replay without state).
3. Check redirect_uri validation.
4. Probe code reuse.
5. Report per-check results.

skills.name: Privilege boundary testing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Enumerate roles from http.capture traffic.
2. Replay privileged requests as lower-privileged users (http.replay).
3. Document endpoints lacking enforcement.
4. Automate the matrix with python.run_file.
5. Report a privilege matrix.

skills.name: Business logic abuse
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map a purchase/booking flow via http.capture.
2. Replay with negative/zero quantities, reordered steps (http.replay).
3. Observe acceptance of invalid states.
4. Document economic impact hypothetically (no real orders).
5. Report flow weaknesses.

skills.name: Race condition testing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify single-use or limited resources via http.capture.
2. Replay concurrent requests with http.capture.repeat small bursts.
3. Observe double-consumption on your own test app.
4. Automate precise timing with python.run_file threads.
5. Report the race window.

skills.name: IDOR automation sweep
skills.description: Sweep object references for authorization gaps.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect object IDs from http.history.
2. Replay with substituted IDs via http.replay on your own test data.
3. Automate the sweep with python.run_file.
4. Record which endpoints leak foreign objects.
5. Report an IDOR matrix.

skills.name: Mass assignment testing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture update requests (http.capture).
2. Add privileged fields (role, isAdmin) via http.replay.
3. Observe acceptance on your own instance.
4. Confirm effect via a read-back request.
5. Report field allowlist remediation.

skills.name: BOLA chain discovery
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map object relationships from http.history.
2. Test cross-object references with http.replay.
3. Automate chain building with python.run_file.
4. Document a full attack path as proof.
5. Recommend object-owner checks.

skills.name: GraphQL API assessment
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Introspect the schema on your own instance (http.replay).
2. Map queries/mutations of interest.
3. Probe batching and depth abuse lightly.
4. Test field-level authz on a few objects.
5. Report with remediation (depth limits, persisted queries).

skills.name: HTTP parameter pollution
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify param-consuming endpoints via http.capture.
2. Send duplicated params with differing values via http.replay.
3. Observe which occurrence wins server-side.
4. Assess security-relevant consequences (price, role).
5. Report parser behavior.

skills.name: Host header abuse
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Replay with attacker host values via http.replay.
2. Observe password-reset/link generation behavior.
3. Test cache-key implications lightly.
4. Document poisoning preconditions.
5. Report with strict host validation fix.

skills.name: Request smuggling triage
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Compare front/back server behavior with ambiguous Content-Length via http.replay.
2. Use timing and benign diffs only; never poison shared caches.
3. Document proxy/stack fingerprints.
4. Escalate only with explicit permission.
5. Report with stack-level remediation.

skills.name: Web cache deception checks
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify cacheable paths via response headers (http.capture).
2. Replay path-variant requests via http.replay.
3. Check whether private responses get cached.
4. Keep tests off shared production caches.
5. Report header/config fixes.

skills.name: CSRF enforcement review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture state-changing requests (http.capture).
2. Replay without tokens via http.replay.
3. Check SameSite and Origin checks indirectly.
4. Document token scoping gaps.
5. Report per-endpoint enforcement.

skills.name: CSP bypass analysis
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Fetch CSP headers (web.headervuln).
2. Analyze allowances (unsafe-inline, wildcards) with python.run_file.
3. Identify bypass primitives.
4. Verify a benign inline marker via web.browser.
5. Report tightened policy text.

skills.name: WebSocket endpoint abuse
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture the WS handshake and frames (tcpdump.capture).
2. Replay frames with altered identities via python.run_file client.
3. Test cross-origin origin checks.
4. Document auth on subscribe/publish.
5. Report enforcement gaps.

skills.name: Upload chain assessment
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate upload endpoints (web.crawl).
2. Test extension/MIME/content validation layers with benign files (http.replay).
3. Map the storage location from responses.
4. Check execution preconditions hypothetically.
5. Report the validation model.

skills.name: SSTI PoC snippet library
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect engine-specific detection strings into a workspace file (file.write).
2. Implement a sender helper with python.run_file.
3. Run detection across targets on your scope.
4. Record hits with engine versions.
5. Keep the library updated.

skills.name: Injection recon sweep
skills.description: Run the full injection recon across a target.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Enumerate inputs (web.dirbrute + http.history).
2. Apply one probe class per input with python.run_file orchestration.
3. Aggregate signals into a matrix.
4. Escalate only promising, authorized findings.
5. Output a prioritized shortlist.

skills.name: PoC quality standards
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Structure: docstring, target, usage, safe default.
2. Include --dry-run and explicit consent flag.
3. Log each request/response pair to a file.
4. Fail closed on unexpected responses.
5. Ship with file.write and test on your lab target.

skills.name: Vulnerability write-up prep
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Reproduce from a clean state; record exact steps.
2. Capture minimal evidence (two requests max per finding).
3. Redact secrets and personal data.
4. Add impact and fix sections.
5. Store as markdown via file.write.

skills.name: Remediation advising
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map each finding to concrete controls.
2. Provide code-level and config-level fixes.
3. Order by effort/impact.
4. Add regression-test suggestions.
5. Deliver a remediation checklist.

skills.name: Retest management
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Keep an issue tracker file in the workspace (file.write).
2. Re-run original probes on each fix claim (http.replay).
3. Update status: fixed/partial/open.
4. Notify on regressions.
5. Summarize the trend.

skills.name: Engagement scope management
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Maintain scope.md in the workspace (file.write).
2. Log every tested host with timestamps.
3. Track rate limits and WAF responses.
4. Stop on scope drift; update the file.
5. Close with a compliance summary.

skills.name: Evidence collection discipline
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Save request/response pairs via http.history export to files.
2. Redact tokens automatically with python.run_file.
3. Hash and timestamp evidence files.
4. Index them for the report.
5. Verify hashes before writing the report.

skills.name: Exploitation safety limits
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Never run destructive payloads on production.
2. Prefer read-only proofs.
3. Cap automated request counts.
4. Back off on errors/5xx storms.
5. Record all limits in the engagement file.

skills.name: Client storage audit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open the target in web.browser.
2. Inspect localStorage/cookies via JS evaluation where possible.
3. Report token placement (never echo values).
4. Recommend HttpOnly/secure storage patterns.
5. Summarize exposure.

skills.name: Third-party JS audit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List external scripts on the page (process.exec curl + python.run_file parse).
2. Check SRI presence.
3. Note script origins and versions.
4. Report supply-chain exposure.
5. Recommend SRI and allowlisting.

skills.name: API schema drift detection
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Baseline key endpoints with http.capture.
2. Re-capture after releases.
3. Diff payloads with python.run_file.
4. Flag breaking changes.
5. Notify with a change report.

skills.name: Token lifecycle assessment
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture token refresh flows (http.capture).
2. Test replay of old tokens via http.replay.
3. Check revocation after password change on your instance.
4. Document lifetime policies.
5. Report gaps.
